title: Ultrahuman battery figure
description: A white section with one big battery figure over a product render: 'label — 12 DAYS — label' in a row on desktop (stacked on phones) above a soft glow arc and a render filling the lower half. As it scrolls in, a title fades up and away, the labels slide in from the sides (from above and below on phones), the figure grows from 92% while its digits roll up from zero, and the glow arc sweeps in from the left.
notes: window-tall on desktop, content-sized (about 530px) on phones
CSS scroll-driven; static HTML and reduced motion show the figure (the title only appears while animating)
name: ultrahuman-battery

props.name: title
props.description: the title shown first, which fades away as the figure arrives

props.name: before
props.description: the small label before the figure, e.g. "Up to"

props.name: value
props.description: the figure itself; its digits roll up from 0 while scrolling in, e.g. "12"

props.name: unit
props.description: the word after the figure, e.g. "Days"

props.name: after
props.description: the small label after the figure, e.g. "Per charge"

props.name: media
props.description: the product render filling the lower half (contain); a placeholder when empty

props.name: arc
props.description: the light-arc art drawn above the render; a soft glow band when empty

props.name: mediaLabel
props.description: describes the render for screen readers when the placeholder shows
